description.intro: The Nike FC Barcelona 26/27 Dri-FIT Stadium kit for kids allows youngsters to wear the colors of their favorite team with the same style as the first team players. It incorporates the innovative Barça design with different shades of blue and red inspired by the renewed Spotify Camp Nou. The set includes a matching t-shirt, shorts and socks to offer a complete match look.
key_benefits: Complete set: Includes matching t-shirt, shorts and socks.
Nike Dri-FIT: Helps keep you fresh and comfortable for longer.
Official FC Barcelona design: Inspired by the kit worn by the first team.
Light and soft fabric: Designed to offer comfort to babies from 3 to 36 months.

source.intro: La equipación Nike FC Barcelona 26/27 Dri-FIT Stadium para niño permite a los más jóvenes vestir los colores de su equipo favorito con el mismo estilo que los jugadores del primer equipo. Incorpora el innovador diseño azulgrana con diferentes tonalidades de azul y rojo inspirado en el renovado Spotify Camp Nou. El conjunto incluye camiseta, pantalón corto y medias a juego para ofrecer una imagen completa de partido.
